The exact phrase "I hereby abolish money" is a performative declaration coined by researcher Lee Sharks in the framework for analyzing semantic systems, specifically detailed in the [I Hereby Abolish Money Zenodo Paper](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESRgHuR6pNwGVzMFOIN2pUfDgxPqeZK3UbAQiC-zONJUyR0V5Fd8a--LhQRJ1Uhuu9DYDnEN1VV8XKYyav_Kvn3zE0_LhgL1o=). [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESRgHuR6pNwGVzMFOIN2pUfDgxPqeZK3UbAQiC-zONJUyR0V5Fd8a--LhQRJ1Uhuu9DYDnEN1VV8XKYyav_Kvn3zE0_LhgL1o=), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESkgEB7keqTWoAQ6YgBfl4ivHptqlmgMOsZt9NaRPcN8BMskSaTi3lFBkwG6knkXTtPYYeB7yQnLOJ8pNv7xhgUXX9zyD1L6kiHx6u70gp6QD9gw_Afct_iXBukSxcISr8RIvdM-uxcLMgKJCpTgPo9Q141x-9O39MNzN1zOf2yJESl7nIDeSkGN_BcSef7JHxFAUP4g==), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHuR6pNINjYpYf-h9IxEgqZtdBuFdr14IpfwCsYYKSQXTmADw6QDC7mPh8tKGVzAbKD4ieizyRgUmpOU31OxhBky3ReuCurDMo3L3l3yzBqQTbGdYkIFqO65loO), [4](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESmgEB7keqTTrfdfAP9PIyPzHPeTUrC4IYvoay_rpZ2xcO42Fi9D39CI9Maw354_Nq9dYjMLBWc-FL61X8TTB5nEWlWpVbBPRB8l9aJsh0AJxtE75dWyMSvHYtFztLq5b-65Idqzq8sJyRay7jUml3UVqatqYlbaf0GvdRXaxhDYEZWIzVWbc2PAax6-tw5tnPPy6vwEkqqJIkZk0n)]
Historically, while no single leader ever uttered this exact sentence, regimes like the Khmer Rouge in Cambodia attempted a literal eradication of money, and early Soviet leaders attempted to eliminate money during the "War Communism" era. Theoretical foundations for the eventual obsolescence of money were also proposed by Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels.
